scripts.title: teleportation script
scripts.script:
--[[
    Teleport Saver v7 (Final)
    - No minimize button
    - Working close button (X)
    - Instant teleport
    - All buttons rounded
    - Black color scheme
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local savedPos = nil
local isDragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil

-- Instant teleport
local function teleportInstant(character, targetPos)
    local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return false end
    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos)
    return true
end

-- GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "TeleportSaver"
screenGui.Parent = CoreGui

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 170)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.5, -85)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)          -- pure black
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.ClipsDescendants = true
frame.Parent = screenGui

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
frameCorner.Parent = frame

-- Title bar
local titleFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
titleFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 35)
titleFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
titleFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)  -- dark gray
titleFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
titleFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleFrame.Parent = frame

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
titleCorner.Parent = titleFrame

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 35)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
title.Text = "📍 Teleport"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 17
title.Active = true
title.Selectable = true
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = titleFrame

-- Close button (X)
local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 1)
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 30, 30)   -- dark red
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeBtn.TextSize = 18
closeBtn.Parent = titleFrame

local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn

-- Content container
local contentContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
contentContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -50)
contentContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 45)
contentContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
contentContainer.Parent = frame

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
layout.Parent = contentContainer

-- Save button
local saveBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
saveBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 170, 0, 38)
saveBtn.Text = "💾 Save Position"
saveBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)     -- dark gray
saveBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
saveBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
saveBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
saveBtn.TextSize = 15
saveBtn.Parent = contentContainer

local saveCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
saveCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
saveCorner.Parent = saveBtn

-- Load button
local loadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
loadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 170, 0, 38)
loadBtn.Text = "📂 Load Position"
loadBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)     -- dark gray
loadBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
loadBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
loadBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
loadBtn.TextSize = 15
loadBtn.Parent = contentContainer

local loadCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
loadCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
loadCorner.Parent = loadBtn

-- Info label
local infoLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
infoLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
infoLabel.Text = "Position not saved"
infoLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
infoLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
infoLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
infoLabel.TextSize = 13
infoLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
infoLabel.Parent = contentContainer

-- Notification
local notification = Instance.new("TextLabel")
notification.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
notification.Text = ""
notification.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
notification.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0, 0.5)
notification.BackgroundTransparency = 1
notification.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
notification.TextSize = 13
notification.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
notification.Visible = false
notification.Parent = contentContainer

-- Functions
local function updateInfo()
    if savedPos then
        infoLabel.Text = string.format("Saved: (%.1f, %.1f, %.1f)", savedPos.X, savedPos.Y, savedPos.Z)
    else
        infoLabel.Text = "Position not saved"
    end
end

local function showNotification(text, color)
    color = color or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
    notification.Text = text
    notification.BackgroundColor3 = color
    notification.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
    notification.Visible = true
    task.wait(1.5)
    notification.Visible = false
end

-- Handlers
local function onSave()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        showNotification("❌ Character not found!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
        return
    end
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then
        showNotification("❌ HumanoidRootPart not found!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
        return
    end
    savedPos = hrp.Position
    updateInfo()
    showNotification("✅ Saved!", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0))
    saveBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 100)
    task.wait(0.2)
    saveBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
end

local function onLoad()
    if not savedPos then
        showNotification("⚠️ Save position first!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0))
        return
    end
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        showNotification("❌ Character not found!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
        return
    end
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then
        showNotification("❌ HumanoidRootPart not found!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
        return
    end
    
    loadBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
    task.wait(0.2)
    loadBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
    
    if teleportInstant(character, savedPos) then
        showNotification("✅ Teleported!", Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255))
        infoLabel.Text = string.format("Teleported to (%.1f, %.1f, %.1f)", savedPos.X, savedPos.Y, savedPos.Z)
    else
        showNotification("❌ Teleport error!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
    end
end

-- Connect events
saveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onSave)
saveBtn.TouchTap:Connect(onSave)

loadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onLoad)
loadBtn.TouchTap:Connect(onLoad)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    screenGui:Destroy()
end)
closeBtn.TouchTap:Connect(function()
    screenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Dragging
local function startDrag(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        isDragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = frame.Position
    end
end

local function updateDrag(input)
    if not isDragging then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end

local function endDrag(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        isDragging = false
    end
end

title.InputBegan:Connect(startDrag)
title.InputChanged:Connect(updateDrag)
title.InputEnded:Connect(endDrag)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        isDragging = false
    end
end)

-- Initialization
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 170)
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
updateInfo()
print("[Teleport Saver] Loaded. All buttons are rounded, dark theme.")

scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/gen2"))()

local window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "HSK Hub",
    LoadingTitle = "HSK Hub",
    LoadingSubtitle = "Rayfield UI",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = false
    },
    Discord = {
        Enabled = false
    },
    KeySystem = false
})

-- 탭 생성 ("기본" 및 "로컬")
local mainTab = window:CreateTab({
    Name = "기본",
    Icon = 93364949241311
})

local localTab = window:CreateTab({
    Name = "로컬",
    Icon = 4370318686 -- 로컬 전용 아이콘
})

-- 서비스 로드
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

----------------------------------------------------
-- 상태 변수 및 유틸 함수
----------------------------------------------------
local autoCoinEnabled = false
local fastShootEnabled = false
local hitboxEnabled = false
local hitboxSize = 15
local predictEnabled = false
local espEnabled = false
local dangerEnabled = false
local alertEnabled = false
local gunEspEnabled = false
local noclipEnabled = false
local infJumpEnabled = false
local speedEnabled = false
local targetSpeed = 32
local fullbrightEnabled = false
local fovEnabled = false
local targetFov = 70
local freecamEnabled = false

local notifiedPlayers = {}
local currentMurdererChar = nil
local noclipConn = nil
local infJumpConn = nil
local gunHighlight = nil

-- ESP 폴더 및 위기 경고 레이블 (CoreGui)
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local espFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
espFolder.Name = "ESP_Folder"
espFolder.Parent = CoreGui

local WarningLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
WarningLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 45)
WarningLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.1, 0)
WarningLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
WarningLabel.Text = "⚠️ 살인자 접근 중! ⚠️"
WarningLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
WarningLabel.TextSize = 16
WarningLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
WarningLabel.Visible = false
WarningLabel.Parent = CoreGui

local WarnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
WarnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
WarnCorner.Parent = WarningLabel

-- 탄궤적 예측 파트
local predictPart = Instance.new("Part")
predictPart.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
predictPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
predictPart.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("New Yeller")
predictPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
predictPart.CanCollide, predictPart.Anchored, predictPart.Transparency = false, true, 0.3

-- 역할 스캔 함수
local function checkRole(player)
	local isM, isS = false, false
	local function scanContainer(c)
		if not c then return end
		for _, item in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Tool") then
				local n = string.lower(item.Name)
				if n:find("knife") or n:find("칼") or n:find("blade") then isM = true end
				if n:find("gun") or n:find("총") or n:find("revolver") or n:find("pistol") then isS = true end
			end
		end
	end
	if player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then scanContainer(player.Backpack) end
	if player.Character then scanContainer(player.Character) end
	return isM, isS
end

-- 떨어진 총 찾기 함수
local function getDroppedGun()
	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Tool") then
			local lN = string.lower(obj.Name)
			if (lN:find("gun") or lN:find("총") or lN:find("revolver") or lN:find("pistol")) and obj.Parent == Workspace then 
                return obj 
            end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- [기본 탭] UI 요소 정의
----------------------------------------------------

mainTab:CreateSection("파밍 & 전투")

-- 광속 동전 자석
mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "🧲 광속 동전 자석 흡수",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "AutoCoinToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        autoCoinEnabled = Value
    end,
})

-- 노 리로드 / 빠른 사격
mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "⚡ 노 리로드 / 빠른 사격",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "FastShootToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        fastShootEnabled = Value
    end,
})

-- 히트박스 확장 입력 및 토글
mainTab:CreateInput({
    Name = "히트박스 크기",
    PlaceholderText = "기본 값: 15",
    RemoveTextOnFocusLost = false,
    Callback = function(Text)
        hitboxSize = tonumber(Text) or 15
    end,
})

mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "📦 히트박스 확장",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "HitboxToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        hitboxEnabled = Value
        if not Value then
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local root = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                    root.Size, root.Transparency, root.CanCollide = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), 1, true
                end
            end
        end
    end,
})

-- 탄궤적 예측
mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "🎯 탄궤적 예측 가이드",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "PredictToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        predictEnabled = Value
        if not Value then predictPart.Parent = nil end
    end,
})

mainTab:CreateSection("ESP & 탐지")

-- 역할 ESP
mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "👁️ 역할 ESP (살인자/보안관)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "EspToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        espEnabled = Value
        if not Value then espFolder:ClearAllChildren() end
    end,
})

-- 실시간 무기 감지
mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "🚨 실시간 무기 감지 알림",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "AlertToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        alertEnabled = Value
        if not Value then notifiedPlayers = {} end
    end,
})

-- 살인자 접근 경고
mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "⚠️ 살인자 접근 경고",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "DangerToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        dangerEnabled = Value
    end,
})

-- 떨어진 총 ESP
mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "🔫 떨어진 총 ESP",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "GunEspToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        gunEspEnabled = Value
    end,
})

-- 떨어진 총으로 TP
mainTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "🚀 떨어진 총으로 TP",
    Callback = function()
        local gun = getDroppedGun()
        if gun and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local handle = gun:FindFirstChild("Handle") or gun
            if handle:IsA("BasePart") then 
                LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = handle.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0) 
            end
        end
    end,
})

mainTab:CreateSection("이동 유틸리티")

-- 무한 점프
mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "🦘 무한 점프",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "InfJumpToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        infJumpEnabled = Value
        if Value then
            infJumpConn = UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
                if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                    LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                end
            end)
        else
            if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect() end
        end
    end,
})

-- 위로 TP (+50칸)
mainTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "⬆️ 위로 TP (+50칸)",
    Callback = function()
        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
        end
    end,
})

mainTab:CreateSection("시야 & 카메라")

-- 풀브라이트
mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "💡 풀브라이트 (맵 밝게)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "FullbrightToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        fullbrightEnabled = Value
        if Value then
            Lighting.Brightness = 2
            Lighting.ClockTime = 14
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        else
            Lighting.Brightness = 1
            Lighting.ClockTime = 12
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
        end
    end,
})

-- FOV 변경
mainTab:CreateInput({
    Name = "시야각(FOV) 입력",
    PlaceholderText = "기본 값: 70",
    RemoveTextOnFocusLost = false,
    Callback = function(Text)
        targetFov = tonumber(Text) or 70
    end,
})

mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "🔍 시야각(FOV) 고정/변경",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "FovToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        fovEnabled = Value
        if not Value then Camera.FieldOfView = 70 end
    end,
})

-- 프리캠
mainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "📷 카메라 프리캠 (정찰)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "FreecamToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        freecamEnabled = Value
        if Value then
            Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        else
            Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                Camera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            end
        end
    end,
})

----------------------------------------------------
-- [로컬 탭] UI 요소 정의 (이동 속도 & 노클립)
----------------------------------------------------

localTab:CreateSection("플레이어 이동 제어")

-- 이동 속도 변경
localTab:CreateInput({
    Name = "이동 속도 입력",
    PlaceholderText = "기본 값: 32",
    RemoveTextOnFocusLost = false,
    Callback = function(Text)
        targetSpeed = tonumber(Text) or 32
    end,
})

localTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "⚡ 이동 속도 변경",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "SpeedToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        speedEnabled = Value
        if not Value and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").WalkSpeed = 16
        end
    end,
})

-- 노클립
localTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "👻 노클립 (벽 통과)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "NoclipToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        noclipEnabled = Value
        if Value then
            noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
                if LocalPlayer.Character then
                    for _, p in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do 
                        if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end 
                    end
                end
            end)
        else
            if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect() end
        end
    end,
})

----------------------------------------------------
-- 메인 서비스 백그라운드 루프들
----------------------------------------------------

-- Heartbeat 루프 (동전 자석, 알림, 속도, 무기 패스트 샷, 총 ESP)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    -- 동전 자석
	if autoCoinEnabled and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		local root = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
		for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			local name = string.lower(obj.Name)
			if name:find("coin") or name:find("동전") or name:find("money") then
				local targetPart = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or (obj:IsA("Model") and (obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")))
				if targetPart then targetPart.CFrame = root.CFrame end
			end
		end
	end

    -- 무기 알림
    if alertEnabled then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player ~= LocalPlayer then
				local isM, isS = checkRole(player)
				if isM and not notifiedPlayers[player.Name .. "_M"] then
					notifiedPlayers[player.Name .. "_M"] = true
					pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "⚠️ [살인자 경고]", Text = player.Name .. " 님이 칼을 들었습니다!", Duration = 5}) end)
				elseif isS and not notifiedPlayers[player.Name .. "_S"] then
					notifiedPlayers[player.Name .. "_S"] = true
					pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "🛡️ [보안관 알림]", Text = player.Name .. " 님이 총을 들었습니다!", Duration = 5}) end)
				end
			end
		end
	end

    -- 역할 ESP & 위기 경고
    local murdererPlayer = nil
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
			local char = player.Character
			local hl = espFolder:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
			if espEnabled and not hl then
				hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
				hl.Name = player.Name
				hl.Adornee = char
				hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
				hl.Parent = espFolder
			end
			local isM, isS = checkRole(player)
			if isM then murdererPlayer = player end
			if espEnabled and hl then
				hl.FillColor = isM and Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) or (isS and Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100))
			end
		end
	end
	currentMurdererChar = (murdererPlayer and murdererPlayer.Character and murdererPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and murdererPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health > 0) and murdererPlayer.Character or nil
	if dangerEnabled and murdererPlayer and murdererPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character then
		local myR, murR = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), murdererPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if myR and murR then WarningLabel.Visible = ((myR.Position - murR.Position).Magnitude <= 35) end
	else
		WarningLabel.Visible = false
	end

    -- 노 리로드
    if fastShootEnabled and LocalPlayer.Character then
		local function applyFast(tool)
			if tool:IsA("Tool") then
				local lN = string.lower(tool.Name)
				if lN:find("gun") or lN:find("총") or lN:find("revolver") or lN:find("pistol") then
					if tool:FindFirstChild("Cooldown") then tool.Cooldown.Value = 0 end
					if tool:FindFirstChild("ReloadTime") then tool.ReloadTime.Value = 0 end
					if tool:FindFirstChild("Debounce") then tool.Debounce.Value = false end
				end
			end
		end
		for _, item in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren()) do applyFast(item) end
		if LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then for _, item in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do applyFast(item) end end
	end

    -- 스피드 (로컬 탭 기능)
    if speedEnabled and LocalPlayer.Character then
		local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = targetSpeed end
	end

    -- 떨어진 총 ESP
    if gunEspEnabled then
        local gun = getDroppedGun()
        if gun then
            if not gunHighlight then
                gunHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                gunHighlight.Name = "GunHighlight"
                gunHighlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
                gunHighlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                gunHighlight.Parent = CoreGui
            end
            gunHighlight.Adornee = gun
        else
            if gunHighlight then gunHighlight:Destroy() gunHighlight = nil end
        end
    else
        if gunHighlight then gunHighlight:Destroy() gunHighlight = nil end
    end
end)

local function createFly()
	if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or not rootPart then getCharacter() end

	if flyAttachment then flyAttachment:Destroy(); flyAttachment = nil end

	flyAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")

	flyAttachment.Parent = rootPart

	flyVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	flyVelocity.Name = "MateyFlyVelocity"
	flyVelocity.Attachment0 = flyAttachment
	flyVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	flyVelocity.MaxForce = math.huge
	flyVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
	flyVelocity.Parent = rootPart

	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
end

local function stopFly()
	flyEnabled = false
	if flyVelocity then flyVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero; flyVelocity:Destroy(); flyVelocity = nil end
	if flyAttachment then flyAttachment:Destroy(); flyAttachment = nil end
	if humanoid then humanoid.AutoRotate = true; humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end

--========================================================
-- FLY MOVEMENT
--========================================================

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not flyEnabled then return end
	if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or not rootPart or not flyVelocity then stopFly(); return end

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end

	local joystickDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
	if joystickDirection.Magnitude < 0.05 then flyVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero; return end

	local cameraLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local cameraRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector
	local horizontalCamera = Vector3.new(cameraLook.X, 0, cameraLook.Z)
	if horizontalCamera.Magnitude > 0 then horizontalCamera = horizontalCamera.Unit end

	local right = Vector3.new(cameraRight.X, 0, cameraRight.Z)
	if right.Magnitude > 0 then right = right.Unit end

	local forwardAmount = joystickDirection:Dot(horizontalCamera)
	local sideAmount = joystickDirection:Dot(right)
	local verticalAmount = forwardAmount * cameraLook.Y

	local finalDirection = (horizontalCamera * forwardAmount) + (right * sideAmount) + Vector3.new(0, verticalAmount, 0)
	if finalDirection.Magnitude > 1 then finalDirection = finalDirection.Unit end

	flyVelocity.VectorVelocity = finalDirection * flySpeed
end)

	local function readNum()

			adv(2)

	while pos<=len do

			adv()

		elseif isA(c) then
			while pos<=len and isAN(byte()) do adv() end

			if KW[w] then addT("keyword",w, w, sP, sC, sL) else addT("identifier",w, w, sP, sC, sL) end

			if byte(1)==46 and byte(2)==46 then adv(3); addT("punctuation","...", "...", sP, sC, sL)

			else adv(); addT("punctuation",".", ".", sP, sC, sL) end
		elseif c==61 then
			if byte(1)==61 then adv(2); addT("punctuation","==", "==", sP, sC, sL) else adv(); addT("punctuation","=", "=", sP, sC, sL) end

			if byte(1)==61 then adv(2); addT("punctuation","<=", "<=", sP, sC, sL) else adv(); addT("punctuation","<", "<", sP, sC, sL) end
		elseif c==62 then
			if byte(1)==61 then adv(2); addT("punctuation",">=", ">=", sP, sC, sL) else adv(); addT("punctuation",">", ">", sP, sC, sL) end
		elseif c==58 then
			if byte(1)==58 then adv(2); addT("punctuation","::", "::", sP, sC, sL) else adv(); addT("punctuation",":", ":", sP, sC, sL) end
		elseif c==47 and byte(1)==47 then adv(2); addT("punctuation","//", "//", sP, sC, sL)
		else
			local ch=string.char(c)
			adv(); addT("punctuation",ch, ch, sP, sC, sL)
		end
	end

	return toks
end

local function renameVars(toks)
	local scope = {{}}
	local globalRename = {}

	local PROTECTED = {
		["print"]=1,["tostring"]=1,["tonumber"]=1,["type"]=1,["pairs"]=1,
		["ipairs"]=1,["next"]=1,["select"]=1,["unpack"]=1,["rawget"]=1,
		["rawset"]=1,["rawequal"]=1,["setmetatable"]=1,["getmetatable"]=1,
		["pcall"]=1,["xpcall"]=1,["error"]=1,["assert"]=1,["require"]=1,
		["math"]=1,["string"]=1,["table"]=1,["bit32"]=1,["os"]=1,["io"]=1,
		["game"]=1,["workspace"]=1,["script"]=1,["Instance"]=1,
		["Vector2"]=1,["Vector3"]=1,["Color3"]=1,["UDim"]=1,["UDim2"]=1,
		["CFrame"]=1,["Enum"]=1,["Rect"]=1,["TweenInfo"]=1,["BrickColor"]=1,
		["Region3"]=1,["Ray"]=1,["NumberRange"]=1,["ColorSequence"]=1,
		["task"]=1,["coroutine"]=1,["_G"]=1,["_ENV"]=1,["self"]=1,
		["wait"]=1,["spawn"]=1,["delay"]=1,["typeof"]=1,["warn"]=1,
		["tick"]=1,["time"]=1,["collectgarbage"]=1,
	}

	local nameMap = {}

	local function getTok(i)
		while toks[i] and toks[i].type == "newline" do i=i+1 end
		return toks[i], i
	end

	local function collectLocals()
		local i=1
		while i<=#toks do
			local t, nxt = getTok(i)
			if not t then break end
			i = nxt
			
			if t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="local" then
				local nj = i+1
				local t2, j = getTok(nj)
				if t2 and t2.type=="keyword" and t2.value=="function" then
					local t3, k = getTok(j+1)
					if t3 and t3.type=="identifier" and not PROTECTED[t3.value] then
						if not nameMap[t3.value] then nameMap[t3.value]=newVar() end
					end
				elseif t2 and t2.type=="identifier" then
					while t2 and t2.type=="identifier" do
						if not PROTECTED[t2.value] and not nameMap[t2.value] then
							nameMap[t2.value]=newVar()
						end
						local tComma, nk = getTok(j+1)
						if tComma and tComma.type=="punctuation" and tComma.value=="," then
							t2, j = getTok(nk+1)
						else break end
					end
				end
			elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="function" then
				local nj = i+1
				local tj, j = getTok(nj)
				while tj and not (tj.type=="punctuation" and tj.value=="(") do
					tj, j = getTok(j+1)
				end
				tj, j = getTok(j+1)
				while tj and not (tj.type=="punctuation" and tj.value==")") do
					if tj.type=="identifier" and not PROTECTED[tj.value] and not nameMap[tj.value] then
						nameMap[tj.value]=newVar()
					end
					tj, j = getTok(j+1)
				end
			elseif (t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="for") then
				local nj = i+1
				local tj, j = getTok(nj)
				while tj and not (tj.type=="keyword" and tj.value=="in") and not (tj.type=="punctuation" and tj.value=="=") do
					if tj.type=="identifier" and not PROTECTED[tj.value] and not nameMap[tj.value] then
						nameMap[tj.value]=newVar()
					end
					local tComma, nk = getTok(j+1)
					if tComma and tComma.type=="punctuation" and tComma.value=="," then
						tj, j = getTok(nk+1)
					else break end
				end
			end
			i=i+1
		end
	end
		collectLocals()

	local result = {}
	for _,t in ipairs(toks) do
		if t.type=="identifier" and nameMap[t.value] then
			local newName = nameMap[t.value]
			t.value = newName
			t.raw = newName
			t.length = #newName
			result[#result+1]=t
		else
			result[#result+1]=t
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function parseAST(toks)
	local tp=1
	local function T()
		while toks[tp] and toks[tp].type == "newline" do tp = tp + 1 end
		return toks[tp] or {type="eof", value="EOF", raw="EOF"}
	end
	local function Tt() return T().type end
	local function Tv() return T().value end
	local function Pt(n)
		local tmp = tp
		local c = 0
		while true do
			while toks[tmp] and toks[tmp].type == "newline" do tmp = tmp + 1 end
			c = c + 1
			if c >= n then break end
			tmp = tmp + 1
		end
		local x = toks[tmp]
		return x and x.type or "eof"
	end
	local function Pv(n)
		local tmp = tp
		local c = 0
		while true do
			while toks[tmp] and toks[tmp].type == "newline" do tmp = tmp + 1 end
			c = c + 1
			if c >= n then break end
			tmp = tmp + 1
		end
		local x = toks[tmp]
		return x and x.value or ""
	end
	local function adv()
		tp=tp+1
		while toks[tp] and toks[tp].type == "newline" do tp = tp + 1 end
	end
	local function chk(t,v) if v then return T().type==t and T().value==v end return T().type==t end
	local function eat(t,v)
		if not chk(t,v) then error("Expected "..t..(v and " '"..v.."'" or "").." got "..T().type.." '"..tostring(T().value).."'") end
		local r=T(); adv(); return r
	end
	local function try(t,v) if chk(t,v) then adv(); return true end end

	local parseExpr,parseStat,parseBlock,parseFB

	local BOPS={["or"]=1,["and"]=2,["<"]=3,[">"]=3,["<="]=3,[">="]=3,["=="]=3,["~="]=3,
		[".."]=4,["+"]=5,["-"]=5,["*"]=6,["/"]=6,["%"]=6,["//"]=6,["^"]=7}
	local RASS={["^"]=true,[".."]=true}
	local ENDS={["end"]=1,["else"]=1,["elseif"]=1,["until"]=1,["eof"]=1}

	local function pSfx(base)
		while true do
			if chk("punctuation",".") then
				adv(); local f=eat("identifier").value
				base = { type="MemberExpression", base=base, identifier=f }
			elseif chk("punctuation","[") then
				adv(); local idx=parseExpr(); eat("punctuation","]")
				base = { type="IndexExpression", base=base, index=idx }
			elseif chk("punctuation",":") then
				adv(); local m=eat("identifier").value
				eat("punctuation","(")
				local args={}
				if not chk("punctuation",")") then
					args[#args+1]=parseExpr()
					while try("punctuation",",") do args[#args+1]=parseExpr() end
				end
				eat("punctuation",")")
				base = { type="CallExpression", base=base, method=m, arguments=args, isSelf=true }
			elseif chk("punctuation","(") then
				adv(); local args={}
				if not chk("punctuation",")") then
					args[#args+1]=parseExpr()
					while try("punctuation",",") do args[#args+1]=parseExpr() end
				end
				eat("punctuation",")")
				base = { type="CallExpression", base=base, arguments=args, isSelf=false }
			elseif chk("string") then
				local sv=T().value; adv()
				base = { type="CallExpression", base=base, arguments={{type="Literal", kind="string", value=sv}}, isSelf=false }
					elseif chk("punctuation","{") then
			adv()
			local fields={}
			while not chk("punctuation","}") do
				if chk("identifier") and Pt(2)=="punctuation" and Pv(2)=="=" then
					local k=T().value; adv(); adv()
					fields[#fields+1]={ key={type="Literal", kind="string", value=k}, value=parseExpr() }
				elseif chk("punctuation","[") then
					adv(); local k=parseExpr(); eat("punctuation","]"); eat("punctuation","=")
					fields[#fields+1]={ key=k, value=parseExpr() }
				else fields[#fields+1]={ key=nil, value=parseExpr() } end
				if not try("punctuation",",") then try("punctuation",";") end
			end
			eat("punctuation","}")
			base = { type="CallExpression", base=base, arguments={{type="TableLiteral", fields=fields}}, isSelf=false }
			else break end
		end
		return base
	end

	local function pPrim()
		local t=T()
		if t.type=="number" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="number", value=tonumber(t.value) }
		elseif t.type=="string" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="string", value=t.value }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="true" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="boolean", value=true }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="false" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="boolean", value=false }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="nil" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="nil", value=nil }
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="..." then adv(); return { type="VarargLiteral" }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="function" then adv(); return parseFB()
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="(" then
			adv(); local e=parseExpr(); eat("punctuation",")"); return pSfx(e)
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="not" then adv(); return { type="UnaryExpression", operator="not", argument=pPrim() }
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="-" then adv(); return { type="UnaryExpression", operator="-", argument=pPrim() }
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="#" then adv(); return { type="UnaryExpression", operator="#", argument=pPrim() }
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="~" then adv(); return { type="UnaryExpression", operator="~", argument=pPrim() }
				elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="{" then
			adv()

			while not chk("punctuation","}") do
				if chk("identifier") and Pt(2)=="punctuation" and Pv(2)=="=" then
					local k=T().value; adv(); adv()

				elseif chk("punctuation","[") then
					adv(); local k=parseExpr(); eat("punctuation","]"); eat("punctuation","=")
					fields[#fields+1]={ key=k, value=parseExpr() }
				else fields[#fields+1]={ key=nil, value=parseExpr() } end

	end

		parseExpr = function(mp)
		mp=mp or 0
		local node=pPrim()
		while true do
			local op=T().value
			local pr=BOPS[op]
			if not pr or pr<=mp then break end
			
			if (op=="+" or op=="-" or op=="*" or op=="/" or op=="%" or op=="^" or op=="..") and Pt(2)=="punctuation" and Pv(2)=="=" then
				break
			end
			
			adv()
			local np2=RASS[op] and pr-1 or pr
			local right=parseExpr(np2)
			node={ type="BinaryExpression", operator=op, left=node, right=right }

		return node

		eat("punctuation","(")

		local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","end")
		return { type="FunctionDefinition", params=params, isVararg=isva, body=body }
	end

	parseStat = function()
		local t=T()
		if t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="local" then
			adv()

			else

				if try("punctuation","=") then
					values[#values+1]=parseExpr()
					while try("punctuation",",") do values[#values+1]=parseExpr() end
				end

			end
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="function" then
			adv(); local n=eat("identifier").value; local chain={n}
			while chk("punctuation",".") do adv(); chain[#chain+1]=eat("identifier").value end
			local isM=false
			if chk("punctuation",":") then adv(); chain[#chain+1]=eat("identifier").value; isM=true end
			local fb=parseFB()
			return { type="GlobalFunctionDefinition", chain=chain, isMethod=isM, functionDef=fb }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="return" then
			adv(); local args={}
			if not ENDS[Tv()] and not chk("punctuation",";") then
				args[#args+1]=parseExpr()
				while try("punctuation",",") do args[#args+1]=parseExpr() end
			end
			try("punctuation",";")
			return { type="ReturnStatement", arguments=args }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="if" then
			adv(); local clauses={}
			clauses[#clauses+1]={ condition=parseExpr(), body=parseBlock() }
			while chk("keyword","elseif") do
				adv(); clauses[#clauses+1]={ condition=parseExpr(), body=parseBlock() }
			end
			local elseBody=nil
			if try("keyword","else") then elseBody=parseBlock() end
			eat("keyword","end")
			return { type="IfStatement", clauses=clauses, elseBody=elseBody }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="while" then
			adv(); local cond=parseExpr(); eat("keyword","do"); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","end")
			return { type="WhileStatement", condition=cond, body=body }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="repeat" then
			adv(); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","until"); local cond=parseExpr()
			return { type="RepeatUntilStatement", body=body, condition=cond }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="for" then
			adv(); local vn=eat("identifier").value
			if try("punctuation","=") then

				if try("punctuation",",") then step=parseExpr() end

				while try("punctuation",",") do iters[#iters+1]=parseExpr() end

			end
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="do" then
			adv(); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","end"); return { type="DoStatement", body=body }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="break" then
			adv(); return { type="BreakStatement" }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="continue" then
			adv(); return { type="ContinueStatement" }
						elseif t.type=="identifier" or (t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="(") then
			local firstExpr = parseExpr()
			local isCompound = false
			local cOp = ""
			local nxtVal = T().value

			end

			if isCompound then
				local rhs = { parseExpr() }
				while try("punctuation",",") do rhs[#rhs+1] = parseExpr() end
				try("punctuation",";")
				rhs[1] = { type="BinaryExpression", operator=cOp, left=firstExpr, right=rhs[1] }
				return { type="AssignmentStatement", lhs={firstExpr}, rhs=rhs }
			elseif chk("punctuation","=") or chk("punctuation",",") then
				local lhs = { firstExpr }
				while try("punctuation",",") do lhs[#lhs+1] = parseExpr() end
				eat("punctuation","=")
				local rhs = { parseExpr() }
				while try("punctuation",",") do rhs[#rhs+1] = parseExpr() end
				try("punctuation",";")
				return { type="AssignmentStatement", lhs=lhs, rhs=rhs }
			else

				return { type="ExpressionStatement", expression=firstExpr }
			end
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value==";" then adv()
		else adv() end
		try("punctuation",";")
	end

	parseBlock = function()
		local block = {}
		while Tt()~="eof" and not (Tt()=="keyword" and ENDS[Tv()]) do
			local s=parseStat()
			if s then block[#block+1]=s end

			for _, cj in ipairs(lctx.continues) do patch(p, cj, p_ir2) end
			
			local li = emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); 
			emit(p, OC.M_FORLOOP)
			
			patch(p, pi2, p_ir2 + 1)
			patch(p, li, bodyStart)
			
			for _, bj in ipairs(lctx.breaks) do patch(p, bj, #p.c + 1) end
			popS(p)
														elseif node.type == "ForGenericStatement" then
			pushS(p)
			local itr=nL(p,"__it"); local str2=nL(p,"__st");
			local ctl=nL(p,"__ct")
			
			compileExpr(p, node.iterators[1] or {type="Literal",kind="nil"}, itr)
			
						if node.iterators[1] and node.iterators[1].type == "CallExpression" and not node.iterators[2] then
				for b = #p.c, 1, -1 do
					if p.c[b][1] == OC.M_CALL then
						if p.c[b-1] and p.c[b-1][1] == OC.M_PUSH_LIT then
							p.c[b-1][2] = 3
							local c_base = p.c[b-3][2]
							emitMOVE(p, str2, c_base + 1)
							emitMOVE(p, ctl, c_base + 2)
						end
						break
					end
				end
			end
			
			if node.iterators[2] then compileExpr(p, node.iterators[2], str2) end
			if node.iterators[3] then compileExpr(p, node.iterators[3], ctl) end
			
			local vrs={}
			for _, vname in ipairs(node.variables) do vrs[#vrs+1]=nL(p, vname) end
			
			local call_base = aR(p)
			local call_arg1 = aR(p)
			local call_arg2 = aR(p)
			
			local top=#p.c
			
			emitMOVE(p, call_base, itr)
			emitMOVE(p, call_arg1, str2)
			emitMOVE(p, call_arg2, ctl)
			
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, call_base)
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, 2)
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, #node.variables)
			emit(p, OC.M_CALL)
			
			emitMOVE(p, ctl, call_base)
			
			for i, vr in ipairs(vrs) do 
				emitMOVE(p, vr, call_base + i - 1) 
			end
			
			local 
			nr=aR(p)
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, nr)
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, nr)
			emit(p, OC.M_LOADNIL)
			
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, 1)
			emitPUSH_REG(p, ctl)
			emitPUSH_REG(p, nr)
			emit(p, OC.M_EQ)
			fR(p)
			
			local jf=eJMP(p, 0)
			
			p.loopStack = p.loopStack or {}
			table.insert(p.loopStack, {breaks={}, continues={}})
			
			compileBlock(p, node.body)
			
			local lctx = table.remove(p.loopStack)
			for _, cj in ipairs(lctx.continues) do patch(p, cj, top + 1) end
			
			eJMP(p, top + 1)
			patch(p, jf, #p.c + 1)
			
			for _, bj in ipairs(lctx.breaks) do patch(p, bj, #p.c + 1) end
			popS(p)
		elseif node.type == "DoStatement" then
			pushS(p); compileBlock(p, node.body); popS(p)
				elseif node.type == "BreakStatement" then
			local j = eJMP(p, 0)
			if p.loopStack and #p.loopStack > 0 then
				table.insert(p.loopStack[#p.loopStack].breaks, j)
			end
		elseif node.type == "ContinueStatement" then
			local j = eJMP(p, 0)
			if p.loopStack and #p.loopStack > 0 then
				table.insert(p.loopStack[#p.loopStack].continues, j)
			end
		elseif node.type == "ExpressionStatement" then
			local dr=aR(p); compileExpr(p, node.expression, dr); fR(p)
						elseif node.type == "AssignmentStatement" then
			local compiledRhs={}
			for i, rhsNode in ipairs(node.rhs) do
				local rr=aR(p)
				compileExpr(p, rhsNode, rr)
				compiledRhs[#compiledRhs+1]=rr
				
				if rhsNode.type == "CallExpression" and i == #node.rhs and #node.lhs > i then
					local req_nrv = #node.lhs - i + 1
					for b = #p.c, 1, -1 do
						if p.c[b][1] == OC.M_CALL then
							if p.c[b-1] and p.c[b-1][1] == OC.M_PUSH_LIT then
								p.c[b-1][2] = req_nrv
								local c_base = p.c[b-3][2]
								for j = 1, req_nrv - 1 do
									local evr = aR(p)
									emitMOVE(p, evr, c_base + j)
									compiledRhs[#compiledRhs+1] = evr
								end
							end
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end

			for i, lhsNode in ipairs(node.lhs) do
				local vr=compiledRhs[i]
				if not vr then break end
				
												if lhsNode.type == "Identifier" then
					local r=fL(p, lhsNode.name)
					if r then 
						emitMOVE(p, r, vr)
					else 
						local u = resolveUpval(p, lhsNode.name)
						if u then
							emitPUSH_LIT(p, u)
							emitPUSH_REG(p, vr)
							emit(p, OC.M_SETUPVAL)
						else
							local strID, strKey = getOrAddStrKey(p, lhsNode.name)
							emitPUSH_K(p, strID); emitPUSH_REG(p, vr);
							emit(p, OC.M_SETGLOBAL, strKey) 
						end
					end
				elseif lhsNode.type == "MemberExpression" then
					local tr=aR(p); compileExpr(p, lhsNode.base, tr)
					local strID, strKey = getOrAddStrKey(p, lhsNode.identifier)
					local kr=aR(p); emitPUSH_K(p, strID); emit(p, OC.M_EXEC_SUB, kr, strKey)
					emitPUSH_REG(p, tr); emitPUSH_REG(p, kr); emitPUSH_REG(p, vr); emit(p, OC.M_SETTABLE); fR(p); fR(p)
				elseif lhsNode.type == "IndexExpression" then
					local tr=aR(p); compileExpr(p, lhsNode.base, tr)
					local kr=aR(p); compileExpr(p, lhsNode.index, kr)
					emitPUSH_REG(p, tr); emitPUSH_REG(p, kr); emitPUSH_REG(p, vr); emit(p, OC.M_SETTABLE); fR(p); fR(p)
				end
			end
			for _=1, #compiledRhs do fR(p) end
		end
	end

	compileBlock = function(p, block)
		for _, stat in ipairs(block) do compileStat(p, stat) end
	end

	local root=newP(0)
	root.va=true
	pushS(root)
	compileBlock(root, ast.body)
	emit(root, OC.M_HALT)
	return root
end

local function peepholeOptimize(proto, OC)
	local superMap = {}
	local superCount = 0
	local usedOpcodes = {}
	for _, val in pairs(OC) do usedOpcodes[val] = true end

			local function fop()
		local val
		repeat val = math.random(1, 65535) until not usedOpcodes[val]
		usedOpcodes[val] = true
		return val
	end

		local reverseOC = {}
	for k, v in pairs(OC) do reverseOC[v] = k end

	local function getName(val)
		return reverseOC[val]
	end

	local safeOpMap = {}
		local function isSafeFast(op)
		if safeOpMap[op] ~= nil then return safeOpMap[op] end
		local opName = reverseOC[op]
		if opName and string.sub(opName, 1, 8) == "M_SUPER_" then 
			safeOpMap[op] = false
			return false 
		end
		local safe = op ~= OC.M_JMP and op ~= OC.M_TEST and op ~= OC.M_EQ and 
					 op ~= OC.M_LT and op ~= OC.M_LE and op ~= OC.M_FORPREP and 
					 op ~= OC.M_FORLOOP and op ~= OC.M_CALL and op ~= OC.M_RETURN and 
					 op ~= OC.M_HALT and op ~= OC.M_EXEC_SUB and 
					 op ~= OC.M_GETGLOBAL and op ~= OC.M_SETGLOBAL and op ~= OC.M_LOADBOOL
		safeOpMap[op] = safe
		return safe
	end

	local function findAndApply(p)
		local pairsCount = {}
		local function count(p_inner)
			for i = 1, #p_inner.c - 1 do
				local op1 = p_inner.c[i][1]
				local op2 = p_inner.c[i+1][1]
				
				if isSafeFast(op1) and isSafeFast(op2) then
					local key = (op1 * 256) + op2
					pairsCount[key] = (pairsCount[key] or 0) + 1
				end
			end
			for _, sp in ipairs(p_inner.pr) do count(sp) end
		end
		count(p)

		local bestPair, maxCount = nil, 0
		for k, c in pairs(pairsCount) do
			if c > maxCount then maxCount = c; bestPair = k end
		end

		if maxCount >= 2 then
			local o2 = bestPair % 256
			local o1 = math.floor(bestPair / 256)
			
			superCount = superCount + 1
			local superName = "M_SUPER_" .. superCount
			local superVal = fop()
			OC[superName] = superVal
			reverseOC[superVal] = superName 
			superMap[superName] = {getName(o1), getName(o2)}

						local function apply(p_inner)
				local _skip_next = false
				for i = 1, #p_inner.c - 1 do
					if _skip_next then
						_skip_next = false
					elseif p_inner.c[i][1] == o1 and p_inner.c[i+1][1] == o2 then
						p_inner.c[i][1] = superVal
						_skip_next = true
					end
				end
				for _, sp in ipairs(p_inner.pr) do apply(sp) end
			end
			apply(p)
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	for iter = 1, 15 do
		if not findAndApply(proto) then break end
	end
	return superMap
end

local function serialize(proto, OC, opMap, pk, mathProxy, stringChar, genMathCall, numKey)

	local function sNum(v)
		if v==math.floor(v) and v>=0 and v<=0xFFFF then
			return "("..genMathCall(v, mathProxy)..")"
		end
		return tostring(v)
	end

			local function sK(v)
		if type(v)=="number" then return sNum(v)
		elseif type(v)=="boolean" then return tostring(v)
		elseif v==nil then return "nil"
		elseif type(v)=="table" and v.type=="enc_string" then
			local nums={}
			for i=1,#v.val do nums[i] = bit32.bxor(string.byte(v.val,i), v.key) end
			return "{"..pk.dKey.."={"..table.concat(nums,",").."}}"
										elseif type(v)=="string" then
			if v == "" then return "''" end
			local chunkSize = (#v > 500) and math.random(50, 100) or math.random(2, 4)
			local chunks = {}
			local i = 1
			while i <= #v do
				chunks[#chunks+1] = string.sub(v, i, i + chunkSize - 1)
				i = i + chunkSize
			end

			local memKeys = {}
			local usedKeys = {}
			for _ = 1, #chunks do
				local k
				repeat k = math.random(10000, 99999) until not usedKeys[k]
				usedKeys[k] = true
				memKeys[#memKeys+1] = k
			end

			local insertOrder = {}
			for idx = 1, #chunks do insertOrder[idx] = idx end
			for idx = #insertOrder, 2, -1 do
				local rand = math.random(idx)
				insertOrder[idx], insertOrder[rand] = insertOrder[rand], insertOrder[idx]
			end

			local masterXor = math.random(1, 255)
			local memInit = {}
			for _, idx in ipairs(insertOrder) do
				local chunk = chunks[idx]
				local mKey = memKeys[idx]
				local bytes = {}
				for j = 1, #chunk do bytes[#bytes+1] = bit32.bxor(string.byte(chunk, j), masterXor) end
				memInit[#memInit+1] = "["..mKey.."]={"..table.concat(bytes,",").."}"
			end

						local memVar, ptrVar = newVar(), newVar()
			local genFunc, stateVar, kVar = newVar(), newVar(), newVar()
			local chunkVar, jVar, sVar = newVar(), newVar(), newVar()
			local encK = genMathCall(masterXor, mathProxy)

			return "(function() local "..memVar.."={"..table.concat(memInit, ",").."}; local "..ptrVar.."={"..table.concat(memKeys, ",").."}; local _k="..encK.."; local function "..genFunc.."("..stateVar..") if "..stateVar..">#"..ptrVar.." then return '' end; local "..kVar.."="..ptrVar.."["..stateVar.."]; local "..chunkVar.."="..memVar.."["..kVar.."]; local "..sVar.."=''; for "..jVar.."=1,#"..chunkVar.." do "..sVar.."="..sVar.."..string.char(bit32.bxor("..chunkVar.."["..jVar.."],_k)); end; "..memVar.."["..kVar.."]=nil; local _ret="..sVar..".."..genFunc.."("..stateVar.."+1); "..sVar.."=nil; return _ret; end; return "..genFunc.."(1) end)()"
		else return "nil" end
	end

	local function sProto(p)
		local cp={}
		local order={}
		
						local expH = 0
		local secret_seed = math.random(1000, 9999)

				for i = 1, #p.c do
			local poly_key = ( (i * i * 197) + (i * 83) + secret_seed ) % 4294967296
			
			local ins = p.c[i]
			
			local orig_op = ins[1]
			if orig_op == OC.M_EXEC_SUB or orig_op == OC.M_GETGLOBAL then
				local K_D = bit32.bxor(i, bit32.bxor(bit32.rshift(poly_key, 2), orig_op))
				ins[3] = bit32.bxor(ins[3], K_D)
			elseif orig_op == OC.M_SETGLOBAL then
				local K_D = bit32.bxor(i, bit32.bxor(bit32.rshift(poly_key, 2), orig_op))
				ins[2] = bit32.bxor(ins[2], K_D)
			end

			ins[1] = bit32.bxor(ins[1], poly_key)
			if ins[2] then ins[2] = bit32.bxor(ins[2], poly_key) end
			if ins[3] then ins[3] = bit32.bxor(ins[3], poly_key) end
			
			for j=1, #ins do
				expH = (expH + ins[j]) % 4294967296
			end
		end

				local bcFingerprint = 0
		for i = 1, #p.c do
			local ins = p.c[i]
			for j = 1, #ins do
				bcFingerprint = bit32.bxor(bcFingerprint, ins[j] or 0)
				bcFingerprint = (bcFingerprint * 16777619 + 1) % 4294967296
			end
		end
		local constKey = ( (bcFingerprint * bcFingerprint * 197) + (bcFingerprint * 83) + secret_seed ) % 4294967296
		local ec1v = bit32.bxor(256, constKey)
		local ec2v = bit32.bxor(9, bit32.bxor(constKey, 0x11))
		local ec3v = bit32.bxor(36, bit32.bxor(constKey, 0x22))

				for i=1,#p.c do order[i]=i end
		for i=#order,2,-1 do
			local j=math.random(i)
			order[i],order[j]=order[j],order[i]
		end
						local b92 = " !#$%&()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~"
		local function toB92(num)
			if num == 0 then return string.sub(b92, 1, 1) end
			local res = ""
			while num > 0 do
				local rem = num % 92
				res = string.sub(b92, rem + 1, rem + 1) .. res
				num = math.floor(num / 92)
			end
			return res
		end

		for _,orig_idx in ipairs(order) do
			local ins=p.c[orig_idx]
			local ip={toB92(orig_idx), toB92(ins[1])}
			if ins[2] then ip[#ip+1]=toB92(ins[2]) end
			if ins[3] then ip[#ip+1]=toB92(ins[3]) end
			cp[#cp+1]=table.concat(ip,"'")
		end
		
		local kp={}
		for i=1, #p.k do
			local kv = p.k[i]
			local val_expr = sK(kv)
			if i == 1 then
				kp[#kp+1]="if _c_id == "..(i-1).." then return "..val_expr
			else
				kp[#kp+1]="elseif _c_id == "..(i-1).." then return "..val_expr
			end
		end
		local pool_func = ""
		if #kp > 0 then
			pool_func = "function(_c_id) "..table.concat(kp, " ").." else return nil end end"
		else
			pool_func = "function(_c_id) return nil end"
		end

		local sub_p = {}
		if not p.sub_c or #p.sub_c == 0 then
			p.sub_c = { {OC.SUB_OP_DEC, 0}, {OC.SUB_OP_RET, 0} }
		end
		for _, ins in ipairs(p.sub_c) do
			sub_p[#sub_p+1] = "{"..bit32.bxor(ins[1], secret_seed % 256)..","..bit32.bxor(ins[2] or 0, secret_seed % 256).."}"
		end

				local pp={}
		for _,sp in ipairs(p.pr) do pp[#pp+1]=sProto(sp) end
		
		local uv_p = {}
		if p.upvalues then
			for _, uv in ipairs(p.upvalues) do
				uv_p[#uv_p+1] = "{"..(uv.isLocal and "1" or "0")..","..uv.index.."}"
			end
		end

		local encoded_seed = bit32.bxor(secret_seed, expH % 65536)
				local b92Decoder = "(function(s) local b=' !#$%&()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~' local m={} for i=1,92 do m[string.sub(b,i,i)]=i-1 end local function f(str) local num=0 for i=1,#str do num=num*92+m[string.sub(str,i,i)] end return num end local t={} for p in string.gmatch(s,'([^\"]+)') do local g=string.gmatch(p,\"([^']+)\") local idx=f(g()) local r={} for v in g do r[#r+1]=f(v) end t[idx]=r end return t end)"
		local safe_payload = table.concat(cp, "\""):gsub("\"", "\\\"")
		return "{"..pk.c.."="..b92Decoder.."(\""..safe_payload.."\"),sub_c={"..table.concat(sub_p,",").."},"..pk.k.."="..pool_func
			..","..pk.np.."="..p.np..",upvalues={"..table.concat(uv_p,",").."},"..pk.va.."="..(p.va and 1 or 0)
			..","..pk.pr.."={"..table.concat(pp,",").."},"..pk.mr.."="..(p.mr or 0)..","..pk.hash.."="..expH..","..pk.seed.."="..encoded_seed..","..pk.ec1.."="..ec1v..","..pk.ec2.."="..ec2v..","..pk.ec3.."="..ec3v.."}"
	end
	return sProto(proto)
end
